_doc: Revert-verify mutants for the query predicate analyzer (RFC 308a52c3 «Загрузка по запросу», phase 1a, vault-exodev task 03523fef). Each mutant is a plausible wrong implementation of ONE guarantee and must redden exactly the axes in `expect` (pairwise distinct sets, ITRV §A147). PA axes judge the analyzer's verdict; PD axes judge the guarantee itself on the REAL engine through the CLI path (translate → AlgebraOptimizer.optimize → execute) — full store vs store cut to P'. PA0 (fixture forms) has no mutant by design: it guards the fixture, not the subject. N-mutants come from the independent spec review. `tree`/`subject` are placeholders — run the matrix on a copy with the paths substituted (§A145).

M6_byuuid_not_full_load._note: RFC listed exo:Asset_uid for byUUID; the UUID index covers every loaded subject (a materialized statement edge, a note without the key) — full load is the guarantee.

M16_free_path_hierarchy_only._note: Review finding MEDIUM-4: membership predicates in a free-subject path reach the bridge too (?c ^exo:Instance_class ?s).

M21_orderby_not_walked.from:
for (const comparator of op.comparators)
        walkExpression(comparator.expression, state);
M21_orderby_not_walked.to: for (const comparator of op.comparators) void comparator;
M21_orderby_not_walked._note: Reddens only a verdict axis: the engine's ORDER BY evaluates variables and literals only (QueryExecutor.getExpressionValue, ems__Bug 3cc50b83) — the walk is defensive.
